title: Meta Muse Spaces Build Your Own Mini Apps From a Description
dek: Describe an idea and Meta's Muse AI app builds a personal tool for you.

facts.label: Muse downloads within weeks of launch
Spaces live everywhere Muse is offered
Frontier model behind upgraded Muse models

caption:
What if you could build your own app just by describing it? 🛠️

Meta just launched Muse spaces, a new feature in its Muse AI app. Tell it you want a gift tracker, a trip planner or a daily word game, and Muse builds a custom, interactive space for it. You can keep refining it, pin it to the sidebar, schedule when it shows up, and connect your other apps so it updates in the background with things like concert dates or price changes.

It's Meta's take on vibe-coded personal apps for people who never write code, and it arrives a day after Muse got voice and expressive avatars. Sharing spaces with others is still on the way.

We're tracking every step of the Meta AI push at AI Parabellum. Would you trust Muse with your personal data to build one?
